key_grammar.source_sentence: When people are reminded of deeds they have done that they know were harmful to the environment, they might be left with a feeling of "eco-guilt."

explanation.text: 'deeds they have done'은 'deeds (that/which) they have done'에서 목적격 관계대명사 that/which가 생략된 형태다.
명사(deeds) 뒤에 '주어+동사(they have done)'가 목적어 없이 바로 이어지면 목적격 관계대명사가 생략된 것.
done의 목적어가 비어 있고, 그 자리가 선행사 deeds에 해당한다.
같은 문장의 'that they know were harmful'의 that은 주격이라 생략할 수 없다.

key_grammar.example_analysis: 선행사 deeds 뒤 목적격 관계대명사(that/which)가 생략되고 'they have done'이 바로 수식하는 구조.

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: People [[1|who]] [[2|experience]] eco-guilt [[3|seek]] pro-environmental actions [[4|to compensate]] for this guilt and [[5|restoring]] balance.
drills.fix: to compensate와 병렬 구조이므로 원형 restore가 옳다; restoring은 병렬 오류.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: For instance, people are [[more/very]] likely to sign a petition [[addressing/addressed]] environmental damage after [[viewing/to view]] evidence of human-caused environmental damage.
drills.fix: likely to는 more로 수식, petition을 능동으로 수식하는 현재분사 addressing, 전치사 after 뒤에는 동명사 viewing.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
drills.answer: In their search for such a balance, people are inclined to believing in "quick-fixes," because they want to re-establish the moral balance and escape the guilt as quickly and easily as possible.
drills.fix: be inclined to 뒤에는 동사원형 believe가 와야 함; believing은 오류.
options: Moral licensing has also been observed in the context of cooperation for the good of the environment.

drills.question: 환경 죄책감을 느끼는 사람들은 이 죄책감을 보상하고 균형을 되찾기 위해 친환경적 행동을 추구한다.

sentences.english: Some people are more likely to cheat and steal after purchasing "eco-friendly" products, probably because they feel licensed to do so since they morally account the "eco-friendly" choice as a "good" deed.

chunks.en: Some people are more likely to cheat and steal

chunks.en: after purchasing "eco-friendly" products,
probably because they feel licensed to do so
chunks.ko: 아마도 그렇게 해도 된다는 [[면허(허가)]]를 느끼기 때문이다

chunks.en: since they morally account the "eco-friendly" choice
as a "good" deed.

misreads.statement: 일부 사람들은 '친환경' 제품을 산 뒤 부정행위나 도둑질을 할 가능성이 더 높은데, 그 선택을 '선한' 행위로 여겨 그래도 된다는 면허를 느끼기 때문이다.
사람들이 부정행위를 하는 이유는 친환경 제품이 실제로 품질이 나빠 화가 나기 때문이다.
misreads.anchor: they feel licensed to do so since they morally account the "eco-friendly" choice as a "good" deed
misreads.why: 제품 품질이 아니라 '선한 행위'라는 도덕적 면허 심리 때문.

mistips: feel licensed to do so: '그렇게 해도 된다는 허가를 느끼다'
account A as B: A를 B로 여기다
